title: Current-release solid-route and evidence-boundary refresh
mode: Primary-source release, repository, issue, pull-request, and official consumer documentation review
scope: Refresh current shipping status for open-source ACIS/DWG/DXF peer routes.
Separate released behavior from open branch proposals and app-level 3D workflows.
Convert cross-project evidence into a fast, implementation-ready local and composed-checkpoint protocol.

method.limitations: Repository documentation, release pages, and public issue/PR reports establish declared scope and reported failures only. No current peer binary was executed; issue results remain pinned to their reported artifact or branch and do not establish libdxfrw behavior.

sources.name: ACadSharp release, ACIS writer issue, and dependency pull requests
sources.observed: The latest release page is v3.8.0. Issue #1195 remains open and reports omission against 3.4.9. PR #1240 remains open, reports no deployment, and depends on open PR #1174. A public #1174 branch test report says the AcDs payload-attachment test fails with NotImplementedException and post-2013 DXF payload loss on that branch.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Version/branch-bounded peer report only; no inference about v3.8.0 or libdxfrw without a pinned runtime reproduction.

sources.name: OpenCADStudio release, mutable manifest, codec ancestry, and kernel scope
sources.observed: v2026.42 documents SAT/ACIS model import and broader 3D workflows. The observed mutable-main app manifest pins opencadcodec and opencadkernel revisions. GitHub identifies opencadcodec as a fork of ACadRust; OpenCADKernel describes itself as early and says most operations remain unwritten.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Optional application/kernel observation within the ACadRust codec lineage. Mutable-main dependency pins are not attributed to the release tag absent tag-specific manifest inspection. App workflows and tessellation do not establish embedded DWG AcDs closure or complete B-rep semantics.

sources.name: GDAL current DXF/DWG driver documentation
sources.observed: The stable docs place Binary DXF reader support at GDAL 3.12. The DXF 3D-extensible option exposes AC1027+ ASM bytes and a transform, but modeler entities are skipped by default and OGR geometry is not built from ASM.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Exact-version/options DXF carrier/projection observation only; not a DWG reader, AcDs owner join, writer oracle, or solid semantic kernel.

sources.name: Official FreeCAD DWG import workflow
sources.observed: The stock FreeCAD path converts DWG to intermediate DXF and then uses the selected DXF importer; the documented stock importer does not consume embedded ACIS/SAT solids.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Consumer workflow boundary, not a format rule or local qualification result. Converter, intermediate DXF, importer, and resulting geometry must be measured independently.

plan_impact.acadsharp_release_status: Keep ACadSharp #1195 pinned to its reported 3.4.9 artifact. Do not credit open #1240/#1174 branches as released fixes; inspect and pin v3.8.0 before any optional writer comparison.
plan_impact.opencadstudio: Optional application/kernel consumer under ACadRust lineage; distinguish SAT import from embedded DWG/DXF solids and record app/codec/kernel revisions separately.
plan_impact.gdal: Optional Binary-DXF and AC1027+ ASM carrier/projection route only, pinned to version/options; no B-rep/AcDs promotion.
plan_impact.freecad: Retain the Linux/Windows stock importer checkpoint for 2D/explicit geometry; mark stock ACIS solid consumption not applicable and separate converter, intermediate DXF, and importer outcomes.
plan_impact.local_implementation: At the next ACIS output slice, use a scratch-generated profile and assert source identity, block/INSERT closure, emitted entity type, exact payload or explicit refusal, diagnostics, and transactional publication.
plan_impact.implementation_change: No new local finding, top-level subplan, mandatory peer, dependency, fixture, test, validation-cadence change, or support claim.

repository_state: Plan and research receipt only, in a broadly dirty shared worktree. No changes were staged or committed.
